JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER=function()
 if probe.Complete or probe.Error or not Players[probe.Owner]:IsTurnActive() then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  local localPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
  assert(localPlayer<0 or localPlayer==probe.Owner,'AI probe still uses another human command context')
  assert(not Players[1]:IsTurnActive() and not Players[probe.Owner]:IsHuman(),'AI probe changed controller or turn')
  local manager=Game.GetHeroesManager()
  for _,target in ipairs(probe.Targets) do
   local origin=assert(manager:GetHeroOriginCityID(target.Class))
   assert(manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(target.Class)==probe.Owner and origin.player==probe.Owner,'recall claim/owner changed')
   local city=assert(Players[probe.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
   assert(city:GetX()==target.X and city:GetY()==target.Y,'recall origin changed')
   local building=manager:GetPlayerHeroOriginBuildingType(probe.Owner,target.Class)
   assert(type(building)=='number' and building>=0 and city:GetBuildings():HasBuilding(building),'native recall origin building missing')
   local native=GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[target.Class].UnitType]
   local params={[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_UNIT_TYPE]=native.Hash,[CityCommandTypes.PARAM_YIELD_TYPE]=GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index}
   local visible=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,true,params,false)
   local allowed,results=CityManager.CanStartCommand(city,CityCommandTypes.PURCHASE,false,params,true)
   local alive=0;for _,u in Players[probe.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do if u:GetHeroClassType()==target.Class then alive=alive+1 end end
   local cost=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION)
   probe.Results[#probe.Results+1]={Class=target.Class,Claim=manager:GetHeroClaimPlayer(target.Class),Origin=origin,
    LocalPlayer=localPlayer,OwnerActive=true,IsHuman=false,Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),
    Alive=alive,OriginBuilding=building,Visible=visible,Allowed=allowed,Results=results,Cost=cost,Faith=Players[probe.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance()}
  end
  probe.Complete=true
  print('[JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE] '..A.Canonical(probe))
 end)
 if not ok then probe.Error=tostring(err) end
end
Events.GameCoreEventPublishComplete.Add(JAC_ABSORPTION_AI_PROBE_HANDLER)
return 'strict recall probe prepared for actual AI owner turn; phase='..probe.Phase

local A=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption);local e=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_ABSORPTION_LIVE_RECALL_V1'))
local origin=assert(A.GetHeroesManager():GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class))
local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
local class=assert(GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class].UnitType].FormationClass)
local blockers={}
for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
 if u:GetX()==city:GetX() and u:GetY()==city:GetY() and GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].FormationClass==class then blockers[#blockers+1]=u end
end
table.sort(blockers,function(a,b) return a:GetID()<b:GetID() end)
for _,u in ipairs(blockers) do
 local placed=false;local damage=u:GetDamage();local moves=u:GetMovesRemaining()
 for x=city:GetX()-6,city:GetX()+6 do
  for y=city:GetY()-6,city:GetY()+6 do
   local plot=Map.GetPlot(x,y)
   if not placed and plot and plot:GetOwner()==e.Owner and not plot:IsWater() and not plot:IsImpassable() and (x~=city:GetX() or y~=city:GetY()) then
    local units=Map.GetUnitsAt(plot)
    if not units or units:GetCount()==0 then
     UnitManager.PlaceUnit(u,x,y)
     if u:GetX()==x and u:GetY()==y then u:SetDamage(damage);u:ChangeMovesRemaining(moves-u:GetMovesRemaining());placed=true end
    end
   end
  end
 end
 assert(placed,'no empty owned plot for recall spawn blocker '..u:GetID())
end
return 'recall spawn blockers relocated without deletion: '..#blockers

local api=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_Absorption)
local e=assert(ExposedMembers.JAC_NATIVE_RECALL_CHECKPOINT_READ())
assert(not Players[e.Owner]:IsHuman(),'diagnostic requires the original AI owner')
if JAC_NATIVE_HERO_FAITH_HANDLER then Events.FaithChanged.Remove(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_FAITH_HANDLER) end
if JAC_NATIVE_HERO_COMMAND_HANDLER then Events.CityCommandStarted.Remove(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_COMMAND_HANDLER) end
if JAC_NATIVE_HERO_UNIT_HANDLER then Events.UnitAddedToMap.Remove(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_UNIT_HANDLER) end
local function snapshot()
 local m=Game.GetHeroesManager();local origin=assert(m:GetHeroOriginCityID(e.Class))
 local city=assert(Players[e.Owner]:GetCities():FindID(origin.id))
 local native=GameInfo.Units[GameInfo.HeroClasses[e.Class].UnitType]
 local units={}
 for _,u in Players[e.Owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if u:IsHero() and u:GetHeroClassType()==e.Class then
   units[#units+1]={ID=u:GetID(),Class=u:GetHeroClassType(),X=u:GetX(),Y=u:GetY(),
    Lifespan=u:GetProperty(ExposedMembers.JAC_HeroLifespanKey),Person=u:GetProperty(api.Rules.PERSON_KEY),Token=u:GetProperty(api.Rules.TOKEN_KEY)}
  end
 end
 return {Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn(),Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra(),Owner=e.Owner,Class=e.Class,
  Faith=Players[e.Owner]:GetReligion():GetFaithBalance(),Cost=city:GetGold():GetPurchaseCost(GameInfo.Yields.YIELD_FAITH.Index,native.Hash,MilitaryFormationTypes.STANDARD_MILITARY_FORMATION),
  Claim=m:GetHeroClaimPlayer(e.Class),Origin=origin,Units=units,Record=api.GetRoster(e.Owner)['live:hero']}
end
JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE={Owner=e.Owner,Class=e.Class,Trace={},Before=snapshot()}
assert(#JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE.Before.Units==0,'hero already alive before observation window')
local function observe(kind,data)
 local p=JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE
 if p.Error then return end
 local ok,err=pcall(function()
  assert(#p.Trace<8192,'too many observation events')
  data.Kind=kind;data.Order=#p.Trace+1;data.Turn=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn();data.Era=Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()
  data.Active=Players[e.Owner]:IsTurnActive();data.LocalPlayer=Game.GetLocalPlayer()
  p.Trace[#p.Trace+1]=data
  print('[JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE_EVENT] '..api.Canonical(data))
 end)
 if not ok then p.Error=tostring(err);print('[JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE_ERROR] '..p.Error) end
end
JAC_NATIVE_HERO_FAITH_HANDLER=function(owner,yield,balance)
 if owner==e.Owner then observe('FAITH',{Owner=owner,Yield=yield,Balance=balance}) end
end
JAC_NATIVE_HERO_COMMAND_HANDLER=function(owner,city,districtOwner,district,command,data)
 if owner==e.Owner then observe('COMMAND',{Owner=owner,City=city,Command=command,Data=data}) end
end
JAC_NATIVE_HERO_UNIT_HANDLER=function(owner,id,x,y)
 if owner~=e.Owner then return end
 local kind,class
 for _,u in Players[owner]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if u:GetID()==id then kind=GameInfo.Units[u:GetType()].UnitType;class=u:GetHeroClassType() end
 end
 observe('UNIT',{Owner=owner,ID=id,Class=class,Type=kind,X=x,Y=y})
end
Events.FaithChanged.Add(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_FAITH_HANDLER)
Events.CityCommandStarted.Add(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_COMMAND_HANDLER)
Events.UnitAddedToMap.Add(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_UNIT_HANDLER)
JAC_NATIVE_HERO_SNAPSHOT=snapshot
return api.Canonical(JAC_NATIVE_HERO_TRACE.Before)
